93c41ba8624d25b9.description: **About Sunera Group** Sunera Group is an entrepreneur-led investment and operating platform focused on building, supporting, and investing in innovative businesses. We combine founder experience, hands-on operating support, and a long-term ownership mindset to help early-stage companies create enduring value. Our portfolio spans AI-driven technology ventures and selected strategic investments, offering exposure to the intersection of startup operations, capital allocation, and company building. **Our ventures and portfolio** Kitab is an AI-powered personal growth and life guidance venture bringing together timeless wisdom, modern science, and personalized digital experiences. Its evolving platform includes AI-powered guidance, structured transformation journeys, and tools to help individuals build greater self-awareness, make progress on personal goals, and document their life stories. As a growing consumer technology venture, Kitab presents hands-on opportunities in product economics, growth measurement, financial planning, and scaling decisions. Sunera Group also supports AI-focused ventures such as 10ex.ai, which is developing agentic approaches to demand generation and revenue operations, alongside other portfolio investments and strategic interests. Each company is at a different stage, requiring disciplined financial stewardship, clear performance reporting, smart capital allocation, and founder-oriented problem solving. This role works across the group rather than being restricted to one company. **The opportunity** We are seeking a hands-on Senior Finance Manager to become the financial backbone of Sunera Group and a trusted partner to our startup founders. You will own accurate books, forecasts, liquidity visibility, financial controls, and compliance coordination across multiple entities—and convert financial data into recommendations for founders and investors. You will also help evaluate opportunities, track portfolio performance, and support investment and fundraising processes. This is an operating-finance role with meaningful exposure to venture investing—not a pure investment analyst, investment banking, or fund-administration position. It is especially suited to a strong finance professional who wants to build the judgment and experience needed for a future career in venture capital, private equity, or portfolio finance leadership. **What you will own** **1. Accounting, controls & compliance** • Own the monthly and quarterly close across portfolio entities: general ledger, reconciliations, intercompany transactions, expense classification, accruals, and management accounts. • Prepare entity-level and consolidated P&L, balance sheet, cash-flow statements, and variance analysis, with clear accounting policies and audit-ready records. • Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, payroll providers, company secretaries, and tax advisors on applicable US/India accounting, tax, statutory, and regulatory obligations. • Build practical approval workflows, expense policies, vendor controls, bookkeeping discipline, and scalable financial systems. **2. FP&A, liquidity & founder reporting** • Build and maintain annual budgets, rolling 12–18 month forecasts, company-level cash runway models, and scenario analyses. • Track burn rate, cash commitments, hiring plans, unit economics, revenue quality, customer acquisition efficiency, and other venture-specific operating KPIs. • Deliver a concise monthly portfolio finance dashboard: actuals vs. plan, cash runway, risks, key decisions, and recommended corrective actions. • Partner with founders to evaluate pricing, headcount, vendor spend, strategic initiatives, and resource allocation. **3. Investments & portfolio management** • Maintain an accurate investment register by company and vehicle: invested capital, ownership, securities, dates, follow-on commitments, and major financing events. • Track cap tables, dilution scenarios, SAFE/convertible instruments, option pools, investment documents, and financing milestones with external legal support. • Build company operating models, comparable-company analysis, basic valuation scenarios, return analyses (MOIC/IRR), and investment performance summaries; flag assumptions and uncertainty. • Support new investment screening, financial due diligence, portfolio reviews, capital allocation discussions, and investment committee materials as opportunities arise. **4. Fundraising, governance & process improvement** • Help startups maintain investor-ready financial models, KPI narratives, data rooms, diligence schedules, and board/investor reporting packs. • Coordinate across founders, investors, banks, and professional advisors while maintaining strict confidentiality and documentation standards. • Automate repeatable reporting and reconciliations with spreadsheets, accounting tools, dashboards, and responsible use of AI-enabled workflows. • Improve finance maturity without imposing unnecessary big-company bureaucracy on early-stage teams. **What you bring** • 5–9 years of progressive accounting, financial reporting, FP&A, transaction advisory, or finance operations experience, including demonstrable end-to-end ownership. • Strong fundamentals in bookkeeping, financial statements, internal controls, financial modeling, budgeting, and cash-flow forecasting. • Experience operating across several entities or business units, or the ability to quickly build and manage a multi-company reporting cadence. • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills; comfort with accounting software (such as Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or Xero) and structured reporting. • Clear business communication, careful execution, sound judgment, integrity, and a hands-on willingness to move between details and strategy. • Genuine interest in startup economics, technology businesses, investment analysis, and a longer-term career in venture capital or private equity. **Especially valuable • CA, CPA, CFA qualification/progress, MBA Finance, or a comparable relevant credentia**l. • Background in startup finance, Big Four audit/transaction advisory, investment banking, family office, or VC/PE portfolio operations. • Exposure to SaaS/AI/consumer-app metrics, equity financing, cross-border US–India structures, and cap-table platforms such as Carta. • Experience with investment due diligence, valuation frameworks, or reporting to company boards or investors.

Headquarters: New York, NY, US; Remote, US

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
The Corporate Strategy team sits at the center of Pinterest within the Strategy & Growth organization, helping to shape and communicate the company's multi-year growth strategy. We serve as the connective tissue between key product, engineering, sales, marketing and other cross-functional teams to accelerate Pinterest innovation and business growth.

This is a rare opportunity to join a company undergoing rapid transformation in a high-impact role, working on the most critical company-wide efforts. The Director of Corporate Strategy will stand up a new team from the ground up, carving out a new muscle for Pinterest that brings clarity and alignment around the existing strategy, shapes future strategic investments and identifies net new business growth opportunities for Pinterest. 

What you’ll do:

• Define the Multi-Year Advertising Strategy: Lead the 3- to 5-year strategic vision for Pinterest’s global advertising business, identifying and prioritizing the most important growth opportunities across upper-funnel brand advertising and lower-funnel performance and shopping solutions.

• Identify and Evaluate New Revenue Opportunities: Assess and prioritize opportunities for market expansion across Pinterest’s first-party and third-party advertising businesses. Partner closely with Business Development and Corporate Development to evaluate build, buy, and partner pathways.

• Lead Competitive Intelligence for the Ad Tech Landscape: Drive ongoing analysis of the competitive and industry landscape, synthesizing key market trends, competitor performance, and external benchmarks into actionable insights for senior leadership.

• Own Strategic Communications for Pinterest’s Advertising Vision: Develop compelling strategic narratives, executive presentations, and board-level materials to communicate Pinterest’s advertising strategy and key initiatives to the Head of Advertising, Chief Product Officer, and Board of Directors.

What we’re looking for:

• Data driven and highly skilled in identifying and synthesizing game-changing insights

• Excellent (verbal, written, visual) communication skills, with proven ability to develop and present compelling narratives to broad audiences

• Strong business judgment, with an owners’ mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity

• Experience in building trusted relationships and influencing senior stakeholders

• Ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization; including getting into the details to “become the expert” on an area of focus, then upleveling and clearly articulating the “so what” for others.

• Curious and knowledgeable about the ads, ecommerce, and broader technology industry

• Self-starter and excited about the prospect of building a team/function from the ground up

• Multiple years of experience in Corporate Strategy, Finance, or a comparable role in high-growth tech companies

• Proven ability with navigating a global organization structure and building strong collaborative relationships with cross-functional teams and stakeholders

• Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a relevant field such as Business Administration, or equivalent experience.

In-Office Requirement Statement:

• We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.

• This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

Jitterbit automates and orchestrates business systems to empower teams, unlock value, and accelerate business transformation. With Jitterbit, organizations can streamline operations, enhance data accessibility, and deliver on a growing list of IT needs more quickly and confidently.

For organizations ready to modernize and innovate, Jitterbit provides a unified AI-infused low-code platform for integration, orchestration, automation, and app development that accelerates business transformation, boosts productivity, and unlocks value. The Jitterbit Harmony platform, including iPaaS, API Manager, App Builder and EDI, future-proofs operations, simplifies complexity and drives innovation for organizations globally.

Job Description

Jitterbit is seeking a Java Backend Software Engineer to join our Engineer team. Jitterbit is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) and API Management platform that has been recognized in the leader quadrant of Gartner for five straight years. Our customers use our iPaaS and API Manager platform to solve mission-critical business problems. What is our challenge? To make it easy to integrate our customers’ systems. In order to do this, we need to build and create a SaaS offering that is reliable, stable, and scalable for our customers. Do you have the design, architecting, and code-writing capabilities to take on this challenge? And can succeed in a big way?

About the Team

The engineering team at Jitterbit believes that the quality of our code reflects directly on us as professionals. We are relentless about crafting a product that is innovative and delivers a memorable user experience; an experience that is fast and robust. As a key engineer on our team, you will collaborate with other engineers, product management, and operations. 

Our culture is fun, fast-paced, performance-oriented, open, and collegial. We are constantly pushing the technology envelope to the edge! We are very distributed and our culture is set up to make all of us very effective working remotely. We believe in hiring talent where it exists.

Key team values:

• Quality-first mindset: We believe code quality directly reflects on us as professionals
• Distributed ownership: Engineers own their subsystems end-to-end, from design to production support
• Mentorship culture: Senior engineers actively develop junior talent and foster technical growth
• Innovation mindset: We constantly explore new technologies and architectural patterns to stay ahead
About the Job

As a Java Backend Software Engineer, you will join our team to design, architect, and implement robust, scalable distributed systems that power our SaaS platform. This role offers significant technical depth and opportunities for engineers ready to grow into more senior responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Design and implement high-performance, fault-tolerant connector integrations and adapters that reliably handle mission-critical business workflows 24x7x365.

• 
Architect distributed microservices following cloud-native design patterns (circuit breakers, bulkheads, observability, etc.) for multi-tenant SaaS environments.

• 
Build and optimize data pipelines handling multiple protocols (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, webhooks) and communication patterns (synchronous, asynchronous, event-driven).

• 
Drive technical decisions on critical subsystems; contribute to RFCs and architectural reviews; mentor junior engineers on system design principles.

• 
Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing; own the operational health and observability of deployed systems.

• 
Collaborate with Product, DevOps, and SRE teams to deliver features, resolve production incidents, and improve platform reliability.

• 
Champion best practices: code reviews, testing strategies (unit, integration, chaos), security hardening, and performance optimization.

• 
Contribute to platform infrastructure and developer experience initiatives that benefit the entire engineering organization.

About You

You are an engineer who can turn ideas into extremely reliable and scalable designs. You code in such a way that other engineers find your code easy to comprehend, modify, and build upon. You believe in the power of Integration and APIs to transform how systems are integrated and how applications are built.

You will be successful in this role if you: 

• 
Enjoy helping and mentoring others around you as you grow and become a successful engineer and developer.

• 
Have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Are capable of working in a distributed team and able to excel in a remote culture.

• 
Are self-driven and able to work on key initiatives.

• 
Take pleasure in making things happen and listen to the input from peers.

• 
Are able to make data-driven decisions.

• 
Are a believer in the best idea strategy regardless of where or who ideas come from.

• 
Are an accountability engineer in the team and passionate about making people succeed through the code you push.

Qualifications

We are looking for:

• 
7+ years designing and building large-scale, distributed backend systems handling high throughput and low latency requirements.

• 
5+ years working with multi-tenant SaaS architectures in production; deep understanding of isolation, rate-limiting, and resource management across tenants.

• 
Proven ability to drive system design and participate in architectural decisions; experience mentoring engineers on design patterns and best practices.

• 
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills; demonstrated ability to diagnose complex, production issues in distributed systems.

• 
Deep experience with microservices architecture, including service decomposition, API design, and inter-service communication patterns.

• 
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure); familiarity with container orchestration (Kubernetes) and serverless patterns.

• 
Strong foundation in software engineering fundamentals: SOLID principles, design patterns, system design, testing strategies (unit, integration, e2e).

Technical Skills and Experience:

• 
Expert-level Java (Java 8+): Strong OOP principles, concurrency, performance tuning, memory management (heap, GC), and the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot, Guava, Netty, etc.).

• 
Protocol expertise: REST, SOAP, GraphQL, gRPC, and related concepts (HTTP semantics, caching, rate limiting, error handling).

• 
Message brokers & event streaming: Hands-on experience with RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS, or similar; understanding of at-least-once delivery, dead-letter queues, and stream processing.

• 
Database technologies: Strong SQL (query optimization, indexing); experience with NoSQL databases (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cassandra) and their consistency trade-offs.

• 
Containerization & orchestration: Proficiency with Docker; practical experience with Kubernetes or container runtimes in production.

• 
Version control: Advanced Git workflows (branching strategies, rebasing, cherry-picking); experience with GitHub or similar platforms.

• 
CI/CD & DevOps: Working knowledge of GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD, or similar; ability to write build pipelines, deployment scripts, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).

• 
OS & systems: Comfortable with Linux command line; understanding of OS-level concepts (memory allocation, processes, file systems, networking).

• 
Observability: Experience with logging (ELK, Splunk), metrics (Prometheus, Grafana), and distributed tracing (Jaeger, Zipkin).

Additional Information

 What You’ll Get:

• Work for a growing leader within the Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS) tech space
• Join a mission-driven company that is transforming the industry by changing the way customers use API creation within business-critical processes. 
• Career development and mentorship
• A flexible, remote-friendly company with personality and heart
Please be advised that Jitterbit does not:

• Conduct interviews through unsecure messaging platforms. 
• Request sensitive personal information, such as social security numbers or bank details, during initial contact. 
• Require payment or fees from applicants at any stage of the hiring process. 
• Offer unrealistic salaries or benefits packages. 

Jitterbit is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

Headquarters: Denmark
 
URL: https://baymard.com/

We’re seeking a full-time, remote Market Research Data Analyst for our company.

Baymard Institute conducts large-scale UX research studies, sharing our findings through a bespoke B2B SaaS platform that serves 2,000+ retailer stores, brands, and agencies across 80+ countries — including 71% of Fortune 500 e-commerce companies. We’re fully distributed, with ~60 team members spanning America and Europe, all committed to advancing ecommerce UX.

What You’ll Do

As our Market Research Data Analyst, you’ll own quantitative survey studies from initial research and questionnaire design through fieldwork, analysis, and publication.

Our Quant Insights team conducts recurring studies examining how consumers research, evaluate, and purchase products and services online across different industries and focused topics. A typical study takes approximately three months from beginning to end. Once one study is completed, you’ll begin the research cycle again in another industry or topic area.

This means the role combines variety in subject matter with consistency in research methodology. You might spend one study investigating how consumers shop for electronics and the next examining how they book flights, while following a similar end-to-end research process each time. However, a significant part of this role involves repeatedly executing and improving a structured research process.

At the same time, the process itself is not fixed.

Our Quant Insights team is relatively new, and our research program continues to evolve. Team members are encouraged to challenge existing approaches, experiment with better methods, improve our tooling and workflows, and propose changes to how studies are designed or executed.

If you identify a better way to design a questionnaire, analyze our data, automate part of the workflow, structure a study, or even rethink part of our research process, we want you to make the case for it and help us improve it.

Your responsibilities will include:

Research & Survey Design

• 

Conducting desk research to understand an industry, its consumers, and the ecommerce experiences we want to investigate.

• 

Translating research objectives into clear, testable research questions.

• 

Designing questionnaires, including question wording, response scales, survey structure, branching, and screening criteria.

• 

Identifying appropriate respondent audiences, quotas, and sample requirements.

• 

Reviewing pilot results and refining questionnaires before full fielding.

• 

Considering potential sources of survey bias, measurement error, and data-quality issues throughout the research process.

Survey & Fieldwork Execution

• 

Programming and QA’ing surveys (we use Alchemer), including logic, quotas, branching, and redirects.

• 

Coordinating with sample providers on feasibility, targeting, and setup (we use PureSpectrum).

• 

Monitoring soft launches and active fieldwork.

• 

Evaluating incoming responses for data-quality issues and determining appropriate cleaning or exclusion criteria.

• 

Troubleshooting issues independently.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

• 

Cleaning, structuring, and analyzing survey datasets.

• 

Conducting descriptive and comparative analyses across questions and respondent segments.

• 

Exploring relationships and meaningful differences within the data while avoiding overinterpretation of results.

• 

Identifying the most meaningful findings from large survey datasets rather than simply reporting every result.

• 

Synthesizing findings across multiple questions to develop broader insights into consumer behavior.

• 

Creating charts and writing analysis takeaways that communicate findings clearly.

• 

Translating quantitative findings into concise, evidence-based insights relevant to ecommerce UX professionals and decision-makers.

Your role may gradually expand to include new or more complex studies, program management, or strategic initiatives, depending on your interests and Baymard’s needs.

Your Daily Tasks

While your exact workload will vary depending on where your current study is in its lifecycle, most of your time will involve activities such as:

• 

Researching consumer behavior within an industry.

• 

Designing and refining survey questions.

• 

Programming and QA’ing surveys.

• 

Reviewing pilot data and determining what should change before launch.

• 

Coordinating sampling and monitoring fieldwork.

• 

Cleaning and preparing survey datasets.

• 

Analyzing overall results and meaningful respondent segments.

• 

Investigating interesting or unexpected patterns in the data.

• 

Determining which findings are meaningful enough to publish.

• 

Creating charts and synthesizing findings into clearly written research insights.

The remainder of your time may involve team discussions, methodology development, documentation, process improvements, tooling, cross-functional collaboration, or experimentation with new approaches.

Who You Are

We’re looking for someone who:

• 

Enjoys both the design and analytical sides of quantitative research.

• 

Likes taking ownership of a research project from an initial question through final findings.

• 

Enjoys working with structured processes and becoming better and more efficient at executing them over time, while offering ideas and initiative to improve and streamline them as needed.

• 

Is naturally detail-oriented and methodical in their work.

• 

Is comfortable troubleshooting and resolving field issues independently, but knows when to escalate larger problems for discussion or review

• 

Communicates clearly and asks precise questions when clarifying requirements.

• 

Enjoys cross-functional work and being involved in the early stages of a program.

What You’ll Need

We’re looking for the following qualifications for this role:

• 

2–3+ years of professional experience in quantitative research, market research, survey research, consumer insights, or a closely related field.

• 

Hands-on experience designing questionnaires and conducting online survey research.

• 

Experience analyzing survey datasets and synthesizing quantitative findings into meaningful conclusions.

• 

A solid understanding of survey design fundamentals, including question wording, response scales, questionnaire structure, screening, and common sources of bias.

• 

Experience working with survey platforms such as Alchemer, Qualtrics, SurveyMonkey, or similar.

• 

Experience using Excel, Google Sheets, statistical software, or other analytical tools to explore and analyze quantitative data.

• 

Comfort interpreting percentages, distributions, cross-tabulations, and differences between respondent groups.

• 

Ability to communicate findings clearly, in writing, to audiences who may not have a research background.

• 

Strong communication skills and a disciplined, detail-oriented working style.

You’ll be part of our growing Quant Insights team and will work closely with the Research, Product, Engineering, and Commercial Operations teams, making collaboration essential.

Practical Details

• 

Location: This is a remote, full-time position from the UK, Ireland, or the EU. Baymard is a registered employer in the UK, IE, and DK.

• 

Language: We expect you to be fully proficient in written English. Written English is critical to this role, and you will have to submit your application/cover letter in English.

• 

Salary: Based on qualifications and country average.

•

About Company

The company is a healthcare technology firm focused on developing data-driven solutions for the life sciences and clinical research industry.

Job Description

Role Overview
We are looking for a Finance Manager– FP&A & Strategy, to own core FP&A (budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial modelling, and investor/board reporting) while directly partnering with our Tech and RCM teams to build MIS trackers and dashboards out of raw operational data — patient engagement, account status, and cohort/retention tracking - not just standard finance reports.

Key Responsibilities
1. Financial Oversight and Management:
• Establish and maintain financial control standards across all teams.
• Lead corporate financial management activities, including P&L analysis, cash flow management, forecasting, debt, and investment management.
• Conduct comprehensive financial risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies.
• Develop and refine financial models to benchmark performance and guide future decisions.
2. Audit and Quality Assurance:
• Manage and coordinate rigorous audit and quality assurance processes to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial data and reporting. 
• Oversee the management of financial metadata, including customer retention, patient churn rate, and employee performance metrics.
3. Strategic Planning and Communication:
• Coordinate with RCM, Tech, Sales, Marketing and other teams. 
• Provide strategic financial guidance and advice to support corporate decision-making by creating and using MIS dashboards. 
• Effectively communicate financial insights and digital health business intricacies to stakeholders and investors.
4. Operational MIS & Data Partnership:
• Partner directly with Technology , RCM and other teams to translate raw, non-financial operational data (patient engagement logs, account status exports, EMR/CRM extracts) into structured MIS trackers and dashboards, building the tracker architecture from scratch, not just populating an existing template. 
• Design and maintain cohort-style retention and engagement trackers (e.g., month-over-month decay of engaged patients/accounts by acquisition cohort), account-status pipelines (e.g., Engaged / UTR1-3 / Ready to Welcome / Pending Clinical Review), and related operational KPI views. 
• Own the ongoing accuracy and structure of these trackers as source data formats and definitions evolve, working iteratively with Tech/RCM rather than waiting on a finalized data feed. 
• Translate operational MIS findings into finance-relevant insight — linking patient/account engagement trends back to revenue, churn, and forecasting.
5. Revenue Cycle Management and Operations:
• Guide and direct medical billing processes and revenue cycle management activities. 
• Collaborate with developers to enhance the functionality and efficiency of internal financial systems.
6. Reporting and Analysis:
• Deliver timely and accurate business reporting, financial metrics, and analysis. 
• Monitor data trends, troubleshoot issues, and develop actionable plans to address financial challenges. 
• Identify root causes of data discrepancies and implement corrective measures to ensure data integrity.
7. Process Optimization and Automation:
• Streamline financial processes and workflows to optimize key performance indicators. 
• Lead efforts to automate financial reporting and business processes, driving efficiency and accuracy. 
• Plan and monitor growth and expenditure rates to support strategic decision-making.
8. Collaboration and Innovation:
• Foster a culture of collaboration and innovation across internal and external teams. 
• Engage with business leaders and cross-functional teams to align financial goals and priorities. 
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance financial performance and operational effectiveness.
9. Investor Research & Mapping:
• Identify and evaluate potential investors (VCs, PEs, and strategic investors) aligned with B2B SaaS and healthcare technology. 
• Build and maintain a structured investor database including investment thesis, ticket size, stage focus, and portfolio companies. 
• Track comparable companies, market activity, and funding trends to inform fundraising strategy.

Skills
• Proven success in strategic financial planning, analysis, and decision-making in complex organizational environments. 
• Extensive experience in financial reporting, analysis, modelling, and audit management. 
• Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of identifying trends, assessing risks, and developing innovative solutions. 
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex financial concepts to stakeholders. 
• Proficiency in financial management software and ERP systems, with experience in system implementation and optimization. 
• Strong leadership abilities, demonstrated by the ability to build and lead high-performing teams. 
• Detail-oriented with a focus on accuracy and integrity in financial reporting and analysis.
 • Adaptability to fast-paced, dynamic environments and effective management of competing priorities.

Qualifications
• Minimum 6 years of progressive financial management experience, including 2 years in a leadership role overseeing financial operations. 
• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred. 
• Professional certification such as CPA (Certified Public Accountant), CFA (Chartered Financial Analyst), or equivalent strongly preferred. 
• Experience with B2B product or product-services start-up preferred. 
• Preferred experience in the healthcare or digital health industry.
